title: Dynamics 365 finance and operations: migrate environments from Lifecycle Services to Power Platform admin center
summary: The migration instructions, preview restrictions and roadmap dates are supported. The cost rating incorrectly describes the change as indirect-cost-only despite documented Power Platform capacity consumption and possible capacity purchases; the licensing field also understates the published product-level requirements.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model; licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions
claims.claim: Licensing is unknown because no migration-specific licence is published.
claims.quote: Customers must acquire and assign appropriate subscription licenses for their users ... Example: Dynamics 365 Commerce, Dynamics 365 Finance, Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management, Dynamics 365 Team Members, and more.
claims.fix: Set licensing.model to included. Replace the licensing notes and the sentence treating the licence as unpublished with: 'Finance and operations apps require appropriate product subscription licences, such as Dynamics 365 Finance or Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management. No migration-specific licence or migration price is published as of November 2026. After migration the environment consumes Power Platform capacity.' Add https://learn.microsoft.com/dynamics365/fin-ops-core/dev-itpro/sysadmin/stay-compliant-user-license-requirement to sources. Narrow the final Open questions bullet to ask whether a separate migration licence or price will be introduced.

claims.where: front matter: cost; rationale: cost
claims.claim: A low cost rating accurately represents the documented costs of this change.
claims.quote: cost: low; Low. ... the known costs are admin time, downtime and capacity ... consumes capacity under the Power Platform capacity model. Standard: low means indirect cost only; medium includes predictable consumption.
claims.fix: Set cost to medium. Replace the cost rationale with: 'Medium. The migrated environment consumes Power Platform capacity, and a storage deficit must be cleared by freeing or purchasing capacity before migration. Admin time and downtime are indirect costs; a separate migration price is not yet published.'
